name: Securities Balance Type 11 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the securities or investment fund balance.

BLOK.name: Blocked
BLOK.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are blocked.

AWAS.name: Available With No Additional Status
AWAS.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are freely available with no specific additional status.

AVAI.name: Available
AVAI.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are available.

BLCA.name: Blocked Corporate Action
BLCA.definition: Balance of financial instrument blocked following a corporate action, including proxy activities.

BLOT.name: Blocked Trading
BLOT.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are blocked for trading.

BLOV.name: Blocked Authenticity
BLOV.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are blocked for verification of authenticity.

BORR.name: Borrowed
BORR.definition: Balance of financial instruments that have been borrowed from another party.

COLI.name: Collateral In
COLI.definition: Balance of securities that belong to a third party and that are held for the purpose of collateralisation.

COLO.name: Collateral Out
COLO.definition: Balance of securities that belong to the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and are deposited with a third party for the purpose of collateralisation.

COLA.name: Eligible For Collateral Purposes
COLA.definition: Balance of securities that are eligible for use for collateral purposes.

MARG.name: Derivatives Margin
MARG.definition: Account is used when financing is by the broker/dealer.

PECA.name: Pending Corporate Action Receipt
PECA.definition: Balance of financial instrument pending receipt following a corporate action.

PEDA.name: Pending Corporate Action Delivery
PEDA.definition: Balance of financial instrument pending delivery following a corporate action.

PLED.name: Pledged
PLED.definition: Balance of securities that belong to and is kept in the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and that are pledged.

REGO.name: Out For Registration
REGO.definition: Balance of financial instruments currently being processed by the institution responsible for registering the new beneficial owner (or nominee).

RSTR.name: Restricted
RSTR.definition: Balance of financial instruments that may only be sold under certain conditions or require legal documents.

TRAN.name: In Transshipment
TRAN.definition: Transaction has been generated due to transformation following a corporate action.

DRAW.name: Drawn
DRAW.definition: Settlement transactions relates to drawn securities.

CLEN.name: Tax Exempt
CLEN.definition: Tax-exempt financial instruments are to be settled.

DIRT.name: Non Tax Exempt
DIRT.definition: Taxable financial instruments are to be settled.

NOMI.name: Registered
NOMI.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are registered (in nominee name or in the name of the beneficial owner).

SPOS.name: Street Position
SPOS.definition: Balance of financial instruments that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner.

UNRG.name: Unregistered
UNRG.definition: Balance of securities that could not be registered due to foreign ownership limitation.

ISSU.name: Issued
ISSU.definition: In issuer agent / depository communication, balance of issued financial instruments for which legal documentation has been received.

QUAS.name: Quasi Issued
QUAS.definition: In issuer agent / depository communication, balance of issued financial instruments for which legal documentation has not yet been received.

LODE.name: Pending On Loan Delivery
LODE.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are pending delivery in relation to a lending transaction.
